messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into French, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE French line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (French) | Back‑Translation (to English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|------------------------------|--------------------------------|--------| | Tant' | “to such a degree” – intensifier | Si | “so” | OK | | è (1) | copular verb “is” | est‑elle | “is (she/it)” | OK | | amara | quality “bitter” | amère | “bitter” | OK | | che | resultative subordinator “that” | que | “that” | OK | | poco | quantifier “little, only slightly” | que | “only” (part of *n’est que*) | OK | | è (2) | copular verb in comparative clause | n’est | “is not” (negated) | OK | | più | comparative “more” | plus | “more” | OK | | morte | noun “death” | mort | “death” | OK | | ma | coordinating conjunction “but” | mais | “but” | OK | | per | preposition of purpose “in order to” | pour | “for / to” | OK | | trattar | infinitive “to treat / discuss” | traiter | “to treat / discuss” | OK | | del | preposition + article “of the” | du | “of the” | OK | | ben | noun “good” | bien | “good” | OK | | ch'i' | relative pronoun “that (I …)” | que | “that” | OK | | vi | locative adverb “there” | là | “there” | OK | | trovai | past “found” | ai trouvé | “have found” | OK | | dirò | future “I will tell” | je dirai | “I will say” | OK | | de | preposition “of” (introducing object) | — | — | **MISSING** | | l'altre | adjective “other” (definite) | les | “the” (plural article) | OK | | cose | noun “things” | choses | “things” | OK | | ch'i' | relative pronoun “that (I …)” | que | “that” | OK | | v' | clitic locative “there” | là | “there” | OK | | ho | auxiliary “have” | ai | “have” | OK | | scorte | past participle “seen” | vues | “seen” | OK |

### Items to Review - **MISSING:** *de* (the preposition “of” in line 9 is omitted in the French rendering). - No WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items were identified. The remaining mappings faithfully convey the source meanings and respect French grammatical requirements.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only French script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final French text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 7** - Original: *Si amère est‑elle que la mort n’est que légèrement plus;* - Issue: none - Corrected: *no change*
- **Line 8** - Original: *mais pour traiter du bien que j’ai trouvé là,* - Issue: none - Corrected: *no change*
- **Line 9** - Original: *je dirai les autres choses que j’ai vues là.* - Issue: missing preposition **de** introducing the object of *dirai* - Corrected: *je dirai **des** autres choses que j’ai vues là.*
```text Si amère est‑elle que la mort n’est que légèrement plus; mais pour traiter du bien que j’ai trouvé là, je dirai des autres choses que j’ai vues là. ```
